# ============================================================
# 2. PRODUCTIVITY CLASSIFICATION
# ============================================================

classify_productivity <- function(planned, actual,
                                  distraction, focus) {
  
  completion <- actual / planned
  
  if (completion >= 0.80 &&
      distraction <= 1.5 &&
      focus >= 4) {
    
    return("High")
    
  } else if (completion < 0.50 ||
             distraction > 3 ||
             focus <= 2) {
    
    return("Low")
    
  } else {
    
    return("Moderate")
  }
}


# ============================================================
# 3. DEFAULT TRANSITION MATRIX
# ============================================================

default_matrix <- function() {
  
  P <- matrix(
    c(
      0.65, 0.30, 0.05,
      0.30, 0.50, 0.20,
      0.15, 0.35, 0.50
    ),
    nrow = 3,
    byrow = TRUE
  )
  
  rownames(P) <- c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
  colnames(P) <- c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
  
  return(P)
}


# ============================================================
# 4. ESTIMATE TRANSITION MATRIX FROM HISTORY
# ============================================================

estimate_matrix <- function(states) {
  
  P <- matrix(0, nrow = 3, ncol = 3)
  rownames(P) <- c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
  colnames(P) <- c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
  
  if (length(states) < 2) {
    return(default_matrix())
  }
  
  for (i in 1:(length(states) - 1)) {
    
    from <- match(states[i], rownames(P))
    to   <- match(states[i + 1], colnames(P))
    
    P[from, to] <- P[from, to] + 1
  }
  
  for (i in 1:3) {
    
    row_total <- sum(P[i, ])
    
    if (row_total > 0) {
      P[i, ] <- P[i, ] / row_total
    } else {
      P[i, ] <- default_matrix()[i, ]
    }
  }
  
  return(P)
}


# ============================================================
# 5. STATIONARY DISTRIBUTION
# ============================================================

stationary_distribution <- function(P) {
  
  pi_vec <- c(1/3, 1/3, 1/3)
  
  for (i in 1:10000) {
    
    new_pi <- as.numeric(pi_vec %*% P)
    
    if (max(abs(new_pi - pi_vec)) < 0.0000001) {
      return(new_pi)
    }
    
    pi_vec <- new_pi
  }
  
  return(pi_vec)
}

    ),
    
    
    # ========================================================
    # MARKOV CHAIN MENU
    # ========================================================
    
    navbarMenu(
      "\U0001F504 Markov Chain",
      
      
      tabPanel(
        "\U0001F504 Transition Matrix",
        br(),
        
        div(class = "card",
            h2("Transition Probability Matrix"),
            p("Rows represent today's productivity. Columns represent
            tomorrow's productivity."),
            tableOutput("matrix"),
            uiOutput("matrix_warning")
        ),
        
        div(class = "card",
            h3("Transition Probability Graph"),
            plotOutput("matrix_plot", height = "400px")
        )
      ),
      
      
      tabPanel(
        "\U0001F4D6 Markov Theory Reference",
        br(),
        
        withMathJax(
          
          div(class = "card",
              h2("Markov Chains -- Exam-Relevant Reference"),
              p("This app is a live worked example of the stochastic
              process material tested on the statistics-heavy actuarial
              exams (e.g. SRM, ASTAM). Below are the core definitions,
              matched to what each tab in this app actually computes.")
          ),
          
          div(class = "theory-box",
              h3("1. State space & transition matrix"),
              p("Your productivity each day is treated as a discrete-time
              Markov chain with state space \\(\\{\\text{High, Moderate, Low}\\}\\).
              The one-step transition matrix \\(P\\) has entries"),
              p("$$P_{ij} = \\Pr(X_{n+1} = j \\mid X_n = i)$$"),
              p("This is exactly the table on the 'Transition Matrix' tab,
              estimated from your history by counting observed
              day-to-day transitions and normalizing each row to sum to 1
              (maximum likelihood estimation for a Markov chain).")
          ),
          
          div(class = "theory-box",
              h3("2. Chapman-Kolmogorov equation & n-step transitions"),
              p("The probability of moving from state \\(i\\) to state \\(j\\)
              in \\(n\\) steps satisfies"),
              p("$$P_{ij}^{(n+m)} = \\sum_k P_{ik}^{(n)} P_{kj}^{(m)},
              \\qquad P^{(n)} = P^n$$"),
              p("The 'Forecast' tab computes exactly this: it repeatedly
              multiplies a state vector by \\(P\\) to project your
              productivity distribution 14 days ahead.")
          ),
          
          div(class = "theory-box",
              h3("3. Stationary (limiting) distribution"),
              p("A distribution \\(\\pi\\) is stationary if"),
              p("$$\\pi P = \\pi, \\qquad \\sum_i \\pi_i = 1$$"),
              p("For an irreducible, aperiodic (ergodic) chain, repeatedly
              applying \\(P\\) from any starting distribution converges to
              this unique \\(\\pi\\) -- that's exactly how the 'Long Run'
              tab finds it: iterating \\(\\pi \\leftarrow \\pi P\\) until it
              stops changing.")
          ),
          
          div(class = "theory-box",
              h3("4. Simulation"),
              p("The 'Simulation' tab draws a random walk on the chain:
              at each step, given the current state \\(i\\), the next
              state is drawn from the categorical distribution given by
              row \\(i\\) of \\(P\\). Over many simulated days, the
              proportion of time spent in each state converges to the
              stationary distribution -- a nice sanity check between the
              two tabs.")
          ),
          
          div(class = "theory-box",

              p("Changing your routine (more study time, less distraction,
              more sleep, better focus) is modeled as perturbing specific
              entries of \\(P\\) -- shifting probability mass away from
              transitioning into 'Low' and toward 'High' -- then
              renormalizing each row and recomputing the stationary
              distribution \\(\\pi\\). It is a scenario, not a causal
              estimate: the size of the shift is an assumption you're
              controlling with the sliders, not something estimated from
              data.")
          )
        )
      ),
      
      
      tabPanel(

      tabPanel(

            numericInput("sim_days", "Number of future days",
                         value = 30, min = 5, max = 365),
            actionButton("run_simulation", "\U0001F3B2 Run Simulation",
                         class = "btn-primary"),
            
            br(), br(),
            
            plotOutput("simulation_plot", height = "350px"),
            tableOutput("simulation_table")
        )
      )
    ),
    
    
    # ========================================================
    # WHAT-IF SCENARIOS
    # ========================================================
    
    tabPanel(
      "\U0001F4A1 What-If Scenarios",
      br(),
      
      div(class = "card",
          h2("What If I Change My Routine?"),
          p("Pick a preset that matches a phase of exam prep, or dial in
          your own routine change with the sliders below.")
      ),
      
      div(class = "scenario-box",
          h3("\U0001F331 Choose a Scenario"),
          
          selectInput("scenario_preset", "Preset scenario",
                      choices = setNames(
                        names(scenario_presets),
                        sapply(scenario_presets, function(x) x$label)
                      )),
          
          uiOutput("scenario_preset_desc"),
          
          hr(),
          
          sliderInput("extra_study", "Increase focused study by:",
                      min = 0, max = 3, value = 1, step = 0.5),
          sliderInput("less_distraction", "Reduce distractions by:",
                      min = 0, max = 4, value = 1, step = 0.5),
          sliderInput("extra_sleep", "Increase sleep by:",
                      min = 0, max = 2, value = 0.5, step = 0.5),
          sliderInput("better_focus", "Improve focus by:",
                      min = 0, max = 2, value = 1, step = 1)
      ),
      
      br(),
      
      h3("Current Routine vs Better Routine"),
      tableOutput("scenario_table"),
      
      br(),
      
      plotOutput("scenario_plot", height = "350px"),
      
      uiOutput("scenario_message")
    )
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 9. SERVER
# ============================================================

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # STORE USER DATA
  # ==========================================================
  
  data_store <- reactiveVal(study_data)
  
  
  # keep the "delete a day" dropdown in sync with the data
  observe({
    d <- data_store()
    
    if (nrow(d) == 0) {
      updateSelectInput(session, "delete_date", choices = character(0))
    } else {
      d <- d[order(d$Date, decreasing = TRUE), ]
      choices <- setNames(as.character(d$Date), format(d$Date, "%d %b %Y (%a)"))
      updateSelectInput(session, "delete_date", choices = choices)
    }
  })
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # CURRENT PRODUCTIVITY STATE
  # ==========================================================
  
  current_state <- reactive({
    classify_productivity(input$planned, input$actual,
                          input$distraction, input$focus)
  })
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # LIVE STATE DISPLAY
  # ==========================================================
  
  output$live_state <- renderUI({
    
    state <- current_state()
    
    if (state == "High") {
      
      div(class = "success-box",
          h2("\U0001F7E2 HIGH PRODUCTIVITY"),
          p("Excellent study day!")
      )
      
    } else if (state == "Moderate") {
      
      div(class = "warning-box",
          h2("\U0001F7E1 MODERATE PRODUCTIVITY"),
          p("You made reasonable progress.")
      )
      
    } else {
      
      div(class = "danger-box",
          h2("\U0001F534 LOW PRODUCTIVITY"),
          p("Use today's data to identify what disrupted your routine.")
      )
    }
  })
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # DAILY SUMMARY
  # ==========================================================
  
  output$daily_summary <- renderTable({
    
    completion <- input$actual / input$planned * 100
    
    accuracy <- if (!is.na(input$problems_attempted) &&
                    input$problems_attempted > 0) {
      round(input$problems_correct / input$problems_attempted * 100, 1)
    } else {
      NA
    }
    
    data.frame(
      Measure = c(
        "Exam", "Topic", "Planned Study", "Actual Study", "Completion",
        "Study Sessions", "Breaks", "Problems Attempted", "Problems Correct",
        "Accuracy", "Mock Score", "Distraction", "Sleep", "Focus", "Productivity"
      ),
      Value = c(
        input$exam,
        input$topic,
        paste0(input$planned, " hours"),
        paste0(input$actual, " hours"),
        paste0(round(completion, 1), "%"),
        input$sessions,
        input$breaks,
        input$problems_attempted,
        input$problems_correct,
        ifelse(is.na(accuracy), "-", paste0(accuracy, "%")),
        ifelse(is.na(input$mock_score), "-", paste0(input$mock_score, "%")),
        paste0(input$distraction, " hours"),
        paste0(input$sleep, " hours"),
        paste0(input$focus, "/5"),
        current_state()
      )
    )
  })
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # SAVE RECORD
  # ==========================================================
  
  observeEvent(input$save, {
    
    new_row <- data.frame(
      Date               = as.Date(input$date),
      Body               = input$body,
      Exam               = input$exam,
      Topic              = input$topic,
      Planned_Hours      = input$planned,
      Study_Hours        = input$actual,
      Sessions           = input$sessions,
      Breaks             = input$breaks,
      Distraction_Hours  = input$distraction,
      Sleep_Hours        = input$sleep,
      Focus              = input$focus,
      Problems_Attempted = input$problems_attempted,
      Problems_Correct   = input$problems_correct,
      Mock_Score         = input$mock_score,
      State              = current_state(),
      stringsAsFactors   = FALSE
    )
    
    old_data <- data_store()
    old_data <- old_data[old_data$Date != new_row$Date, ]
    
    new_data <- rbind(old_data, new_row)
    new_data <- new_data[order(new_data$Date), ]
    
    data_store(new_data)
    
    showNotification(
      paste("Saved:", current_state(), "productivity -", input$exam),
      type = "message"
    )
  })
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # HISTORY
  # ==========================================================
  
  output$history <- renderTable({
    
    d <- data_store()
    req(nrow(d) > 0)
    
    d <- d[order(d$Date, decreasing = TRUE), ]
    
    accuracy <- ifelse(
      !is.na(d$Problems_Attempted) & d$Problems_Attempted > 0,
      paste0(round(d$Problems_Correct / d$Problems_Attempted * 100, 1), "%"),
      "-"
    )
    
    data.frame(
      Date        = format(as.Date(d$Date), "%d %b %Y"),
      Body        = d$Body,
      Exam        = d$Exam,
      Topic       = d$Topic,
      Planned     = paste0(d$Planned_Hours, " h"),
      Studied     = paste0(d$Study_Hours, " h"),
      Problems    = paste0(d$Problems_Correct, "/", d$Problems_Attempted),
      Accuracy    = accuracy,
      Mock        = ifelse(is.na(d$Mock_Score), "-", paste0(d$Mock_Score, "%")),
      Distraction = paste0(d$Distraction_Hours, " h"),
      Sleep       = paste0(d$Sleep_Hours, " h"),
      Focus       = paste0(d$Focus, "/5"),
      State       = d$State
    )
    
  }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE)
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # DELETE A SPECIFIC DAY
  # ==========================================================
  
  observeEvent(input$delete_selected, {
    
    req(input$delete_date)
    
    d <- data_store()
    target <- as.Date(input$delete_date)
    
    d <- d[as.Date(d$Date) != target, ]
    data_store(d)
    
    showNotification(
      paste("Deleted record for", format(target, "%d %b %Y")),
      type = "warning"
    )
  })
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # CLEAR ALL HISTORY
  # ==========================================================
  
  observeEvent(input$clear_all, {
    
    if (isTRUE(input$confirm_clear_all)) {
      
      empty <- data_store()[0, ]
      data_store(empty)
      
      updateCheckboxInput(session, "confirm_clear_all", value = FALSE)
      
      showNotification("All history cleared.", type = "warning")
      
    } else {
      
      showNotification(
        "Check the confirmation box first if you really want to erase everything.",
        type = "error"
      )
    }
  })
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # TRANSITION MATRIX
  # ==========================================================
  
  P <- reactive({
    estimate_matrix(data_store()$State)
  })
  
  output$matrix <- renderTable({
    round(P(), 3)
  }, rownames = TRUE)
  
  output$matrix_warning <- renderUI({
    
    n <- nrow(data_store())
    
    if (n < 15) {
      div(style = "color:#d97706; font-weight:bold; margin-top:15px;",
          paste("\U000026A0 You currently have", n,
                "days. The matrix will become more reliable as you log more real study days.")
      )
    } else {
      div(style = "color:#16a34a; font-weight:bold; margin-top:15px;",
          paste("\U00002713 Matrix based on", n, "days of history.")
      )
    }
  })
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # DASHBOARD METRICS
  # ==========================================================
  
  output$latest_state <- renderText({
    d <- data_store()
    req(nrow(d) > 0)
    tail(d$State, 1)
  })
  
  output$latest_hours <- renderText({
    d <- data_store()
    req(nrow(d) > 0)
    paste0(tail(d$Study_Hours, 1), " h")
  })
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # TOMORROW PREDICTION
  # ==========================================================
  
  tomorrow_probabilities <- reactive({
    
    d <- data_store()
    req(nrow(d) > 0)
    
    latest <- tail(d$State, 1)
    row <- match(latest, c("High", "Moderate", "Low"))
    
    P()[row, ]
  })
  
  output$tomorrow_state <- renderText({
    states <- c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
    states[which.max(tomorrow_probabilities())]
  })
  
  output$high_chance <- renderText({
    paste0(round(tomorrow_probabilities()[1] * 100, 1), "%")
  })
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # PRODUCTIVITY GRAPH
  # ==========================================================
  
  output$productivity_plot <- renderPlot({
    
    d <- data_store()
    req(nrow(d) > 0)
    
    y <- match(d$State, c("Low", "Moderate", "High"))
    
    plot(d$Date, y, type = "o", pch = 19, lwd = 2,
         ylim = c(1, 3), yaxt = "n",
         xlab = "Date", ylab = "Productivity")
    
    axis(2, at = 1:3, labels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High"))
    grid()
  })
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # STUDY HOURS GRAPH
  # ==========================================================
  
  output$hours_plot <- renderPlot({
    
    d <- data_store()
    req(nrow(d) > 0)
    
    plot(d$Date, d$Planned_Hours, type = "l", lwd = 2,
         xlab = "Date", ylab = "Hours",
         ylim = range(c(d$Planned_Hours, d$Study_Hours)))
    
    lines(d$Date, d$Study_Hours, lwd = 3)
    
    legend("topleft", legend = c("Planned", "Actual"),
           lwd = c(2, 3), bty = "n")
    
    grid()
  })
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # MATRIX GRAPH
  # ==========================================================
  
  output$matrix_plot <- renderPlot({
    
    barplot(
      t(P()), beside = TRUE,
      names.arg = c("High", "Moderate", "Low"),
      ylim = c(0, 1),
      ylab = "Probability", xlab = "Today's State",
      legend.text = c("High Tomorrow", "Moderate Tomorrow", "Low Tomorrow"),
      args.legend = list(x = "topright", bty = "n")
    )
    
    grid(nx = NA, ny = NULL)
  })
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # 14-DAY FORECAST
  # ==========================================================
  
  forecast <- reactive({
    
    d <- data_store()
    req(nrow(d) > 0)
    
    latest <- tail(d$State, 1)
    current <- match(latest, c("High", "Moderate", "Low"))
    
    result <- matrix(0, nrow = 15, ncol = 3)
    result[1, current] <- 1
    
    for (i in 2:15) {
      result[i, ] <- result[i - 1, ] %*% P()
    }
    
    data.frame(
      Day = 0:14,
      High = result[, 1],
      Moderate = result[, 2],
      Low = result[, 3]
    )
  })
  
  output$forecast_message <- renderUI({
    
    probs <- tomorrow_probabilities()
    states <- c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
    best <- which.max(probs)
    
    div(class = "card",
        h2(paste("Tomorrow is most likely:", states[best])),
        h3(paste0(round(probs[best] * 100, 1), "% probability"))
    )
  })
  
  output$forecast_plot <- renderPlot({
    
    d <- forecast()
    
    plot(d$Day, d$High, type = "l", lwd = 3, ylim = c(0, 1),
         xlab = "Days Ahead", ylab = "Probability")
    
    lines(d$Day, d$Moderate, lwd = 3, lty = 2)
    lines(d$Day, d$Low, lwd = 3, lty = 3)
    
    legend("right", legend = c("High", "Moderate", "Low"),
           lty = c(1, 2, 3), lwd = 3, bty = "n")
    
    grid()
  })
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # STATIONARY DISTRIBUTION
  # ==========================================================
  
  stationary <- reactive({
    stationary_distribution(P())
  })
  
  output$stationary_table <- renderTable({
    
    s <- stationary()
    
    data.frame(
      State = c("High", "Moderate", "Low"),
      Probability = round(s, 4),
      Percentage = paste0(round(s * 100, 1), "%")
    )
  })
  
  output$stationary_plot <- renderPlot({
    
    s <- stationary()
    
    barplot(s, names.arg = c("High", "Moderate", "Low"),
            ylim = c(0, 1),
            ylab = "Long-Run Probability", xlab = "Productivity State")
    
    grid(nx = NA, ny = NULL)
  })
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # SIMULATION
  # ==========================================================
  
  simulated <- eventReactive(input$run_simulation, {
    
    d <- data_store()
    req(nrow(d) > 0)
    
    states <- c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
    current <- match(tail(d$State, 1), states)
    
    result <- character(input$sim_days)
    
    for (i in 1:input$sim_days) {
      result[i] <- states[current]
      current <- sample(1:3, size = 1, prob = P()[current, ])
    }
    
    return(result)
  })
  
  output$simulation_plot <- renderPlot({
    
    req(simulated())
    
    y <- match(simulated(), c("Low", "Moderate", "High"))
    
    plot(y, type = "s", ylim = c(1, 3), yaxt = "n",
         xlab = "Future Day", ylab = "Productivity")
    
    axis(2, at = 1:3, labels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High"))
    grid()
  })
  
  output$simulation_table <- renderTable({
    
    req(simulated())
    
    counts <- table(factor(simulated(), levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")))
    
    data.frame(
      State = names(counts),
      Days = as.numeric(counts),
      Percentage = paste0(round(counts / length(simulated()) * 100, 1), "%")
    )
  })
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # PRACTICE PERFORMANCE
  # ==========================================================
  
  output$total_problems <- renderText({
    d <- data_store()
    req(nrow(d) > 0)
    sum(d$Problems_Attempted, na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  
  output$overall_accuracy <- renderText({
    d <- data_store()
    req(nrow(d) > 0)
    
    attempted <- sum(d$Problems_Attempted, na.rm = TRUE)
    correct <- sum(d$Problems_Correct, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    if (attempted == 0) {
      "-"
    } else {
      paste0(round(correct / attempted * 100, 1), "%")
    }
  })
  
  output$avg_mock_score <- renderText({
    d <- data_store()
    req(nrow(d) > 0)
    
    scores <- d$Mock_Score[!is.na(d$Mock_Score)]
    
    if (length(scores) == 0) {
      "-"
    } else {
      paste0(round(mean(scores), 1), "%")
    }
  })
  
  output$total_study_hours <- renderText({
    d <- data_store()
    req(nrow(d) > 0)
    paste0(round(sum(d$Study_Hours, na.rm = TRUE), 1), " h")
  })
  
  output$accuracy_plot <- renderPlot({
    
    d <- data_store()
    req(nrow(d) > 0)
    
    d <- d[!is.na(d$Problems_Attempted) & d$Problems_Attempted > 0, ]
    req(nrow(d) > 0)
    
    acc <- d$Problems_Correct / d$Problems_Attempted * 100
    
    plot(d$Date, acc, type = "o", pch = 19, lwd = 2,
         ylim = c(0, 100),
         xlab = "Date", ylab = "Accuracy (%)")
    
    grid()
  })
  
  output$mock_plot <- renderPlot({
    
    d <- data_store()
    req(nrow(d) > 0)
    
    d <- d[!is.na(d$Mock_Score), ]
    
    if (nrow(d) == 0) {
      plot.new()
      text(0.5, 0.5, "No mock exam scores logged yet.")
      return(invisible())
    }
    
    plot(d$Date, d$Mock_Score, type = "o", pch = 19, lwd = 2,
         ylim = c(0, 100),
         xlab = "Date", ylab = "Mock Score (%)")
    
    grid()
  })
  
  output$exam_breakdown <- renderTable({
    
    d <- data_store()
    req(nrow(d) > 0)
    
    agg <- aggregate(
      cbind(Study_Hours, Problems_Attempted, Problems_Correct) ~ Exam,
      data = d, FUN = sum, na.rm = TRUE
    )
    
    agg$Accuracy <- ifelse(
      agg$Problems_Attempted > 0,
      paste0(round(agg$Problems_Correct / agg$Problems_Attempted * 100, 1), "%"),
      "-"
    )
    
    data.frame(
      Exam = agg$Exam,
      Total_Study_Hours = round(agg$Study_Hours, 1),
      Problems_Attempted = agg$Problems_Attempted,
      Problems_Correct = agg$Problems_Correct,
      Accuracy = agg$Accuracy
    )
  })
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # EXAM COUNTDOWN
  # ==========================================================
  
  countdown_data <- reactive({
    
    d <- data_store()
    
    if (input$countdown_exam != "All logged exams") {
      d <- d[d$Exam == input$countdown_exam, ]
    }
    
    d
  })
  
  output$countdown_summary <- renderUI({
    
    d <- countdown_data()
    
    target_total <- input$exam_length_hours * input$hours_per_exam_hour
    hours_logged <- sum(d$Study_Hours, na.rm = TRUE)
    hours_remaining <- max(target_total - hours_logged, 0)
    
    days_remaining <- as.numeric(as.Date(input$exam_date) - Sys.Date())
    
    if (days_remaining <= 0) {
      div(class = "danger-box",
          h3("Your exam date has passed or is today."),
          p("Update the exam date to plan ahead for your next attempt or exam.")
      )
    } else {
      
      required_pace <- hours_remaining / days_remaining
      
      recent <- tail(d[order(d$Date), ], 14)
      recent_pace <- if (nrow(recent) > 0) mean(recent$Study_Hours, na.rm = TRUE) else 0
      
      on_pace <- recent_pace >= required_pace
      
      box_class <- if (on_pace) "success-box" else "warning-box"
      
      div(class = box_class,
          h3(paste0(days_remaining, " days until your exam")),
          p(paste0("Target: ", round(target_total, 0), " total study hours (",
                   input$exam_length_hours, "h exam x ",
                   input$hours_per_exam_hour, " hours/exam-hour).")),
          p(paste0("Logged so far: ", round(hours_logged, 1), " h. Remaining: ",
                   round(hours_remaining, 1), " h.")),
          h4(paste0("Required pace: ", round(required_pace, 2),
                    " h/day  |  Your recent 14-day average: ",
                    round(recent_pace, 2), " h/day")),
          p(if (on_pace) {
            "You're on pace at your recent average. Keep it up."
          } else {
            "You're below the pace needed to hit your target -- consider the Exam Crunch Mode scenario in What-If Scenarios."
          })
      )
    }
  })
  
  output$countdown_progress_bar <- renderUI({
    
    d <- countdown_data()
    
    target_total <- input$exam_length_hours * input$hours_per_exam_hour
    hours_logged <- sum(d$Study_Hours, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    pct <- if (target_total > 0) min(hours_logged / target_total * 100, 100) else 0
    
    div(class = "progress-outer",
        div(class = "progress-inner",
            style = paste0("width:", round(pct, 1), "%;"),
            paste0(round(pct, 1), "%")
        )
    )
  })
  
  output$pace_plot <- renderPlot({
    
    d <- countdown_data()
    req(nrow(d) > 0)
    
    d <- d[order(d$Date), ]
    
    target_total <- input$exam_length_hours * input$hours_per_exam_hour
    hours_remaining <- max(target_total - sum(d$Study_Hours, na.rm = TRUE), 0)
    days_remaining <- max(as.numeric(as.Date(input$exam_date) - Sys.Date()), 1)
    required_pace <- hours_remaining / days_remaining
    
    barplot(
      d$Study_Hours,
      names.arg = format(d$Date, "%d %b"),
      las = 2,
      ylab = "Study Hours",
      xlab = "",
      ylim = c(0, max(c(d$Study_Hours, required_pace)) * 1.2)
    )
    
    abline(h = required_pace, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
    
    legend("topleft",
           legend = paste0("Required pace: ", round(required_pace, 2), " h/day"),
           col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2, bty = "n")
  })
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # WHAT-IF SCENARIO PRESETS
  # ==========================================================
  
  observeEvent(input$scenario_preset, {
    
    preset <- scenario_presets[[input$scenario_preset]]
    
    if (!is.null(preset$extra_study)) {
      updateSliderInput(session, "extra_study", value = preset$extra_study)
      updateSliderInput(session, "less_distraction", value = preset$less_distraction)
      updateSliderInput(session, "extra_sleep", value = preset$extra_sleep)
      updateSliderInput(session, "better_focus", value = preset$better_focus)
    }
  })
  
  output$scenario_preset_desc <- renderUI({
    
    preset <- scenario_presets[[input$scenario_preset]]
    
    p(style = "color:#374151;", preset$desc)
  })
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # BETTER ROUTINE MATRIX
  # ==========================================================
  
  improved_P <- reactive({
    
    base <- P()
    
    improvement <-
      input$extra_study * 0.025 +
      input$less_distraction * 0.035 +
      input$extra_sleep * 0.020 +
      input$better_focus * 0.025
    
    new_P <- base
    
    new_P[1, 1] <- base[1, 1] + improvement
    new_P[1, 3] <- base[1, 3] - improvement
    
    new_P[2, 1] <- base[2, 1] + improvement * 0.8
    new_P[2, 3] <- base[2, 3] - improvement * 0.8
    
    new_P[3, 2] <- base[3, 2] + improvement * 0.5
    new_P[3, 3] <- base[3, 3] - improvement * 0.5
    
    new_P[new_P < 0] <- 0
    new_P <- new_P / rowSums(new_P)
    
    return(new_P)
  })
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # SCENARIO TABLE
  # ==========================================================
  
  output$scenario_table <- renderTable({
    
    current <- stationary_distribution(P())
    improved <- stationary_distribution(improved_P())
    
    data.frame(
      Productivity = c("High", "Moderate", "Low"),
      Current_Routine = paste0(round(current * 100, 1), "%"),
      Better_Routine = paste0(round(improved * 100, 1), "%"),
      Change = paste0(
        ifelse(improved >= current, "+", ""),
        round((improved - current) * 100, 1), " pp"
      )
    )
  })
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # SCENARIO GRAPH
  # ==========================================================
  
  output$scenario_plot <- renderPlot({
    
    current <- stationary_distribution(P())
    improved <- stationary_distribution(improved_P())
    
    values <- rbind(current, improved)
    
    barplot(
      values, beside = TRUE,
      names.arg = c("High", "Moderate", "Low"),
      ylim = c(0, max(values) + 0.15),
      ylab = "Long-Run Probability", xlab = "Productivity State",
      legend.text = c("Current Routine", "Better Routine"),
      args.legend = list(x = "topright", bty = "n")
    )
    
    grid(nx = NA, ny = NULL)
  })
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # SCENARIO INTERPRETATION
  # ==========================================================
  
  output$scenario_message <- renderUI({
    
    current <- stationary_distribution(P())
    improved <- stationary_distribution(improved_P())
    
    change <- (improved[1] - current[1]) * 100
    
    div(class = "scenario-box",
        h3("\U0001F331 What does this mean?"),
        p(paste0(
          "Under your current routine, the estimated long-run proportion ",
          "of High productivity days is ", round(current[1] * 100, 1), "%."
        )),
        p(paste0(
          "Under this scenario, that becomes ", round(improved[1] * 100, 1), "%."
        )),
        h4(paste0(
          "Estimated change: ", ifelse(change >= 0, "+", ""),
          round(change, 1), " percentage points."
        )),
        p("This is a model-based scenario rather than a causal prediction.
        It assumes that the routine change shifts your day-to-day
        transition probabilities by the amount implied by the sliders.")
    )
  })
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # DOWNLOAD
  # ==========================================================
  
  output$download <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() {
      "actuarial_study_history.csv"
    },
    content = function(file) {
      write.csv(data_store(), file, row.names = FALSE)
    }
  )
}


# ============================================================
# RUN APPLICATION
# ============================================================

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
